correctness.rationale: For every NONTRIVIAL nilpotent finite group, the Sylow-Frattini spanning rank test gives the stated piecewise partner count; for d>=2 a pair extends to d generators iff rank{g_p,h_p}>=d_p−d+2, and |Φ| lifts count neighbors. For d=1 nontrivial G is cyclic and Γ_1 is edgeless; formula indeed gives 0. HOWEVER THE ACTUAL UNRESTRICTED CLAIM IS FALSE AT THE TRIVIAL GROUP G={1}: d(G)=0, π(G)=∅, |Φ(G)|=1, empty product ∏ A_p=1, so displayed degree formula yields 1 although Γ_0 has one vertex and degree 0 (or Γ_0 is undefined in versions restricting u>=1). This explicit omitted quantifier boundary prevents correctness PASS for the original all-finite-nilpotent formulation. No repair files supplying the nontrivial restriction were prepared; do not certify the original.
